questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a classical synchronization problem solved using semaphores?
questions.explanation: Semaphores are used for the bounded-buffer, readers-writers and dining philosophers problems. The halting problem is an undecidability result in theory of computation.

questions.question: Two transactions run at the same time on the same account. One of them reads a balance that the other has changed but not yet committed, and makes a wrong decision. Which ACID property has been violated?
questions.explanation: Isolation requires that concurrent transactions do not affect each other; seeing another transaction's uncommitted change breaks it.

questions.question: Which mobile generation introduced digital voice with SMS and MMS and improved security because signals could be encrypted?
questions.explanation: 1G was analog voice only; 2G brought digital voice, SMS/MMS and encryption; 3G added data services.

questions.concept: Sequence of mid indices for an unsuccessful binary search
questions.question: Program 6-2 (binary search) runs on [2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, 17, 19, 23, 29, 31, 37, 41, 43] with key 20. Which sequence of mid index values is computed before it returns -1?
questions.explanation: mid 7 (17 < 20, first = 8); mid 11 (31 > 20, last = 10); mid 9 (23 > 20, last = 8); mid 8 (19 < 20, first = 9). Now first > last, so -1 is returned.

questions.question: An office PC that has no Internet connection gets infected right after an employee plugs in a pen drive used at a cyber cafe. Which mode of malware distribution is this?
questions.explanation: Removable storage devices such as pen drives, SSD cards and mobile phones may carry infected data; the PC had no Internet, ruling out email and downloads.

questions.question: Which is the smallest Java integer data type that can store the value 40000?
questions.explanation: byte holds -128 to 127 and short holds -32,768 to 32,767, so 40000 does not fit. int (up to 2,147,483,647) is the smallest that fits; long also fits but is larger.

questions.question: Which statement about a combinational logic circuit is correct?

options.A: It can store one bit with two complementary outputs
options.B: Its output depends on previously stored states
options.C: It always contains at least one flip-flop
options.D: It does not contain any flip-flops or memory elements

questions.explanation: A combinational circuit has no memory element; storage of a bit with complementary outputs describes a flip-flop, a sequential circuit.

questions.question: A construction firm submits an online bid in response to a government tender for building a highway. Which e-commerce type is this?
questions.explanation: A business selling to or bidding for government work is Business-to-Government (B2G); G2B would be the government providing services to businesses.

questions.concept: Layers of a deep learning network
questions.question: A deep learning network has at least how many layers, and in which layer is the model's prediction made?

options.A: Two layers; prediction is made in the hidden layer
options.B: Three or more layers; prediction is made in the output layer
options.C: Three or more layers; prediction is made in the input layer
options.D: One layer; prediction is made in the output layer

questions.explanation: Deep learning uses neural networks with three or more layers: data enters at the input layer, hidden layers process it, and the output layer makes the prediction.

questions.concept: SJF gives minimum average waiting time
questions.question: Which CPU scheduling algorithm usually achieves the minimum average waiting time for a given set of processes?
questions.explanation: By running the shortest jobs first, SJF reduces the waiting time of most processes, so it is considered the optimal algorithm for minimum average waiting time.

questions.question: After a bug fix during the maintenance phase, a team re-runs the earlier test cases to make sure nothing that previously worked has broken. This is called:
questions.explanation: In maintenance, the current product is tested against previous test cases; this is regression testing.

questions.question: Which of the following are listed as components of an Integrated Development Environment (IDE)? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: An IDE consists of a source code editor, build automation tools, a debugger and a compiler/interpreter. A packet analyser is a networking tool, not an IDE component.

questions.concept: HTML documents saved as ASCII text
questions.question: If a web page is written in a word processor, in which form should the HTML document be saved?
questions.explanation: HTML documents are saved as plain ASCII text so the browser can read the markup.

questions.question: As per the syllabus, the input tape of a Turing machine is:

options.A: Finite and fixed to the input length
options.B: Infinite in length in both directions
options.C: Infinite only towards the left side
options.D: Limited by left and right end markers

questions.explanation: The TM input tape is infinite in both directions; end markers bounding the tape belong to the linear bounded automaton.

questions.question: Which Python data structure stores data in key-value pairs?
questions.explanation: A dictionary stores data as key-value pairs. Lists and tuples are indexed sequences, and a set is an unordered collection of unique values.

questions.question: Into how many types (branches) is Theory of Computation divided?
questions.explanation: The three types are computability theory, computational complexity theory and automata theory; four is the count of primary machines, not branches.

questions.question: The Floyd-Warshall algorithm, used in network routing protocols, is named after:
questions.explanation: Its founders are Robert Floyd and Stephen Warshall; Bellman and Ford gave the Bellman-Ford algorithm.

questions.question: Bluetooth operates in which unlicensed frequency band?
questions.explanation: Bluetooth uses the 2.4 GHz unlicensed band, with a range of about 10 m.

questions.concept: Canonical SOP from truth table rows
questions.question: A 3-input function F(A, B, C) has output 1 only for inputs 001 and 110. What is its canonical SOP expression?
questions.explanation: SOP sums the minterms of rows with output 1: 001 gives A'B'C and 110 gives ABC'. The sum-term product is a POS form.

questions.concept: Layer and device from frame and MAC
questions.question: A device handles data in the form of frames and forwards it using MAC addresses. Which OSI layer and device does this describe?

options.B: Data Link layer, switch or bridge

questions.explanation: Frames and MAC/physical addresses belong to the Data Link layer, where switches and bridges operate.

questions.question: Prolog, a language used in AI, stands for:
questions.explanation: Prolog stands for Programming in Logic; Lisp stands for list processing.

questions.question: What is the unit of data transfer between the CPU and cache memory?
questions.explanation: Transfer between CPU and cache is word transfer; block transfer happens between cache and main memory.

questions.concept: ValueError for right type but inappropriate value
questions.question: Which exception is raised by int('abc')?
questions.explanation: int() receives an argument of the right type (a string) but an inappropriate value that cannot be converted, so ValueError is raised.

questions.question: Which type of database schema describes how users interact with the database system?
questions.explanation: The view schema describes user interaction with the database system and is part of the three-schema architecture.

questions.question: The heart of the DES algorithm is:

options.A: its public and private key pair
options.D: the DES function together with its round structure

questions.explanation: The heart of DES is the DES function and the round structure; DES is symmetric, so it does not use a public/private key pair.
